lines.3: 「I only confessed that to you because I recognized you as a true friend.」
lines.11: She was heading for the rooftop.
lines.12: 「She went up to the roof again?」
lines.13: 「That settles it. She definitely doesn't have any friends. No doubt about it.」
lines.14: For some reason, Crab said it with a faux-Chinese cadence.
